description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying {2}{U}{B}.
Hostage Taker enters the battlefield, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hostage Taker, adding one mana of any color.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
